instructions: Follow the patterns and quality standards in CLAUDE.md. Flag any direct pushes or PRs that bypass the develop → staging → production promotion flow. Flag hardcoded secrets, .env files, or credentials in diffs.

rules.rule: If this PR targets production, verify the source branch is staging. Flag TODOs, FIXME, HACK, console.log, and any WIP markers as errors.
If this PR targets staging, verify the source branch is develop. Warn if it comes from a feature branch directly.
Never approve PRs that include .env files, hardcoded API keys, tokens, or database credentials.

files.description: Project conventions, patterns, and quality standards
